label: Bible Study
prompt: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and _____ spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verse: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
note: Real beauty is inner — a meek and quiet spirit is precious to God.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be _____ in the land of my affliction.
verse: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
note: Joseph names his second son Ephraim: God made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap _____ of fire on his head.
verse: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
note: Feeding your enemy 'heaps coals of fire on his head' — Paul quoting Proverbs 25:22, a kindness that burns.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And take the _____ of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verse: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
note: The armor's last pieces: a helmet for the head, and the only offensive weapon in the kit — the word.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and _____ the girdle of his reins.
verse: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
note: The coming Branch of Jesse wears righteousness and 'faithfulness' as his belt — character worn as clothing.
